source.title: Natural Earth 1:10m rivers and lake centerlines

estuary_supplement.limits: Generalized cartographic estuaries, not survey hydrography. Explicitly reviewed terminal reaches only; no extrapolated mouth positions or replacement of detailed upstream courses.

east_china_mouth_supplement.limits: Only these three node-connected reaches are used. No added city waterways, unrelated tributaries, or guessed upstream rerouting. Current cartography, not a historical reconstruction.

global_mouth_supplement.limits: Explicitly selected node-connected downstream reaches only. No guessed connection to another river or nearest sea; current cartography, not historical hydrography.

inland_river_bridges.limits: One missing inland-delta reach, from existing detailed Niger to the same downstream Niger; no invented sea connection or replacement of existing detailed channels.

civ6Reference.role: Network coverage reference; geographic placement uses Natural Earth vectors.

notes: Only byte 17 of each v12 cell changes; all other bytes and the map version remain unchanged.
Six-bit edge masks encode river presence, not hydraulic flow, discharge or river names.
Existing saves keep their persisted river data; the default world receives the new network.

generationPolicy.source_selection: Base 1:10m rivers, six reviewed 1:110m estuary suffixes, three pinned OSM East China river mouths, six reviewed global OSM tails including the Xingu-Amazon confluence, the pinned NE50m Niger inland-delta bridge, bounded bay-head adaptation inside the pinned Natural Earth ocean polygon, and 22 source-locked short outlet/confluence finishes for this land mask; no regional creek supplements
generationPolicy.lake_centerlines: Only their portions lying in existing dry map cells are eligible
generationPolicy.mouths: Terminal corner may touch water; both cells owning each edge remain dry
generationPolicy.cycles: Collapsed at hex quantization scale, primary stems first; small distributary loops cannot be distinguished reliably from quantization loops
generationPolicy.flow_direction: Not inferred: HFRiverEdges stores shared undirected edges, not upstream/downstream flow
generationPolicy.reference_mod: Civ6 Workshop 973878936 is a composition reference; its warped coordinates are not copied
generationPolicy.known_limits: Cartographic, generalized rivers, not hydrological catchments. Small/seasonal streams and canals omitted. Existing map lakes can split a named river. Quantization moves channels by about one hex.

continuity_finishing.bay_head_adaptation: Ocean-only corridor in the pinned Natural Earth polygon; 1/96-hex raster, <=18-hex source path, <=40 final edges, no existing unrelated river crossings
continuity_finishing.coastal_limit: Only components without an outlet; one short lowland completion per component; no changed water cells or source-headwater attraction
continuity_finishing.interpretation: Short game-scale coastal completion, not surveyed channel geometry or a simulated flow direction

rows.reviewed_exception: Known real source estuary, one dry-bank edge to an independent actual water corner within 0.537 hex. This explicit half-cell coast registration avoids an artificial loop when two separately reviewed distributaries share another shore path. The global 0.65 tangent rule is unchanged.
